blocks.text: Brazilian beauty queen Isabela Fernandes is back in Cebu a year after winning her country’s second Miss Asia Pacific International title. And she has also welcomed the delegates of the pageant’s 2026 edition to the province. For the second year in a row, Cebu is hosting the oldest and longest-running international beauty pageant founded in the Philippines. And all of the events and activities will be taking place there. During last year’s edition, the delegates arrived in Manila where the initial activities were held, including the press presentation and the national costume competition.
